title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive

30,000 - 35,000 + Bonus Hybrid Working (2 Days Office / 3 Days Home) Bicester

The Company

Our client is a well-established national accountancy practice with an excellent reputation for supporting businesses across the UK. Due to continued growth, they are looking to recruit a confident and proactive Sales Executive to join their friendly and ambitious team based in Bicester.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, developing new business opportunities and wants to build a long-term career within a successful professional services organisation.

The Role

As a Sales Executive, you will play a key role in identifying opportunities, engaging with prospective clients and supporting them through the initial stages of their journey with the business. This role offers a blend of telephone-based sales, client relationship management and the opportunity to attend face-to-face client meetings and support the onboarding process.

Key Responsibilities:
- Contact prospective clients via telephone
- Qualify enquiries and identify client requirements
- Build strong relationships with prospective and existing clients
- Book appointments for accountants and consultants
- Attend face-to-face client meetings where required
- Support the onboarding of new clients, ensuring a seamless transition into the business
- Proactively follow up on leads and maintain engagement
- Keep CRM records updated accurately
- Deliver an exceptional customer experience throughout the client journey
- Work collaboratively with colleagues to support business growth objectives

About You
- Confident and professional telephone manner
- Previous experience within sales, telesales, lead generation, appointment setting, customer service or business development
- Comfortable making outbound calls and managing follow-up activity
- Strong relationship-building and communication skills
- Organised with excellent attention to detail
- Self-motivated, proactive and target-driven
- Positive attitude with a genuine desire to help customers
- Keen to meet clients face-to-face and build long-term relationships
- Interested in developing a career within professional or financial services

What's on Offer?
- Salary of 30,000 - 35,000
- Uncapped performance-related bonus scheme
- Hybrid working - 2 days in the office and 3 days working from home
- Enhanced pension scheme
- 21 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Full training and ongoing development
- Opportunity to attend client meetings and play a key part in the onboarding process
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Genuine career progression opportunities within a growing nationwide business
- Monday to Friday working hours with no weekends

title: Trainee Sales Representative
description:
Trainee Sales Representative
Company Overview
This established specialist agency operates within the IT marketing services and technology sector, helping technology organisations generate demand, engage relevant audiences and identify new sales opportunities. Working across the UK, Ireland and international markets, the business combines lead generation, marketing solutions and industry expertise to support technology vendors, distributors, resellers and service providers.
About the Role
Are you confident speaking to people, motivated by targets and curious about technology?
This Trainee Sales Representative opportunity in Banbury offers the chance to build a rewarding career in B2 B sales and IT marketing within a fast-paced, supportive environment.
You ll play a key role in generating and qualifying sales opportunities for established technology brands, engaging directly with IT professionals and decision-makers. Through telephone outreach, personalised email campaigns and effective discovery conversations, you ll identify business needs and connect prospects with relevant technology solutions.
You ll receive structured training, ongoing professional development and opportunities to work towards recognised IT vendor certifications, with a clear progression pathway as you develop your sales and industry expertise.
Duties & Responsibilities
- Conduct B2 B prospecting through cold calling and personalised email outreach to arrange meetings with IT professionals.
- Hold discovery conversations with prospects to understand business needs and qualify relevant sales opportunities.
- Manage targeted outreach campaigns for leading IT vendors, developing knowledge of their products, services and certifications.
- Promote IT technologies and services to IT professionals while representing client brands professionally and effectively.
- Maintain accurate contact databases and ensure CRM records and prospect information remain clean and up to date.
- Produce clear, concise reports detailing qualified sales opportunities and relevant prospect information.
- Work to individual project and client campaign briefs, managing follow-up activity and contact cadences effectively.
- Attend and engage with ongoing client and industry training, including onsite and virtual sessions, and support contact registration for industry events.

Education & Skills Required
- Strong motivation, determination and resilience, with the ability to maintain a positive and energetic approach in a target-driven environment.
- Previous experience in sales, customer service, office-based work or another high-activity environment is advantageous but not essential.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and confident telephone manner.
- Ability to work effectively against targets and KPIs while managing multiple campaigns and priorities.
- Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to produce clear, concise written reports.
- A willingness to learn, respond positively to coaching and develop an understanding of technology, IT and B2 B sales.

Additional Information:
- Hybrid working (following the 2-month training period)
- Monday Thursday 8:30am 5:30pm and Friday 8:30am 12:30pm
- Salary £24,500 plus bonus payment after training period
- Uncapped monthly bonus scheme
- 20 days annual leave (plus bank holiday)
- Christmas shutdown period

Apply Now
If you re motivated, curious and ready to develop a career in sales, lead generation and IT marketing, this Trainee Sales Representative role could be an excellent next step. Apply today if you have the communication skills, determination and enthusiasm to succeed.

title: Procurement Account Manager
description:
Location - Witney

About the Role

My client are looking for a highly organised and customer-focused Internal Account Manager to join their Procurement team. This is a varied role responsible for managing the full lifecycle of internal sales and procurement activities, from initial quotation requests through to ordering, renewals and after-sales support.

Working closely with customers, consultants, suppliers and internal teams, you'll ensure customers receive accurate quotations, timely updates and an excellent service throughout their purchasing journey.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage the end-to-end sales process for designated regions, from quotation through to order fulfilment.
- Produce accurate and competitive quotations within agreed service levels.
- Build strong relationships with schools, consultants, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- Convert approved quotations into sales orders and issue contractual documentation.
- Place and manage orders for hardware, software, licensing and project-related equipment.
- Coordinate with project teams to ensure products are delivered in line with installation schedules.
- Manage software, licensing, broadband and hardware warranty renewals.
- Act as a first point of contact for customer and consultant enquiries.
- Work with suppliers to obtain pricing, product information and lead times.
- Support warranty claims, invoice queries and supplier certification requirements.
- Maintain accurate records within CRM and finance systems.

About You

You'll be someone who enjoys building relationships, thrives in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in delivering excellent customer service.

You will have:
- Previous experience in an internal sales, account management, purchasing or customer service role.
- Strong administration and organisational skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience managing multiple priorities and working to deadlines.
- A high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Confidence communicating with customers, suppliers and colleagues at all levels.
- Good IT skills, including experience using CRM and business systems.
- A proactive and collaborative approach to work.

Desirable Experience
- Experience working within the IT channel or technology sector.
- Understanding of ICT products, services and licensing.
- Experience of procurement processes.
- Knowledge of the education sector and schools market.

If you're looking for a role where you can make a real difference, while developing your commercial and customer relationship skills within a growing organisation, we'd love to hear from you.
